blocks.label: Global share, 2025
blocks.text: Leader in U.S. (25.5%), Canada (23.0%), Brazil (28.1%) and China (10.8%).

items.title: Portfolio
items.text: ID-MTS gel cards, ORTHO BIOVUE column cassettes and ORTHO VISION automation.

items.title: Platforms
items.text: VITROS immunoassays for donor screening (anti-HCV, anti-HBc, HTLV I/II).

items.title: Recent move
items.text: May 2026: FDA 510(k) for updated ORTHO Optix Reader software.
